summary: Session-state predicate: reads the int at this+0x3FC4 and returns true only when it equals 1 or 2 AND the global flag byte at 0x007D1074 is non-zero. Used as a gate by InputCommandDispatchToEntities and TeamRadioNetworkMessageProcessing.

local_names.this: session/context object carrying the state field
local_names.v1: cached value of the state field at this+0x3FC4

operations.description: Reads the int at this+0x3FC4 (dword index 4081) into v1
True only when v1 equals 1 or 2 (the accepted session state values)
Ands the state check with the global flag byte_7D1074 being non-zero
Consumed by InputCommandDispatchToEntities and TeamRadioNetworkMessageProcessing as a session-state gate

unresolved: The concrete meaning of state values 1 and 2 for the session phase field is not established
The meaning of the global byte_7D1074 flag, and the owner class of this, are unknown
